messages.subject: Config path in Debian
parts:
if I run `sudo shiny-server` it work fine
[2013-09-18 17:54:04.796] [INFO] shiny-server - Shiny Server v0.3.6 (Node.js v0.10.15)
[2013-09-18 17:54:04.800] [INFO] shiny-server - Using config file "/usr/local/lib/node_modules/shiny-server/config/default.config"
[2013-09-18 17:54:04.875] [INFO] shiny-server - Starting listener on 0.0.0.0:3838
^C[2013-09-18 17:54:08.212] [INFO] shiny-server - Stopping listener on 0.0.0.0:3838
[2013-09-18 17:54:08.212] [INFO] shiny-server - Shutting down worker processes (with notification)

but if I run `sudo shiny-server start`
[2013-09-18 19:27:41.051] [INFO] shiny-server - Shiny Server v0.3.6 (Node.js v0.10.15)
[2013-09-18 19:27:41.055] [INFO] shiny-server - Using config file "/home/deployer/start"
[2013-09-18 19:27:41.076] [ERROR] shiny-server - Error loading config: File "/home/deployer/start" does not exist
[2013-09-18 19:27:41.078] [INFO] shiny-server - Shutting down worker processes

why config path is "/home/deployer/start"? where /home/deployer is my current work directory
how set this path /usr/local/lib/node_modules/shiny-server/config/default.config ?

# creation init.d script
sudo cp /usr/local/lib/node_modules/shiny-server/config/init.d/debian/shiny-server /etc/init.d/
sudo chmod +x /etc/init.d/shiny-server
sudo update-rc.d shiny-server defaults
sudo /etc/init.d/shiny-server stop 2>/dev/null
sudo /etc/init.d/shiny-server start

messages.author: a3cdb14968620c10
messages.subject: Re: Config path in Debian
parts:
I encountered the same problem today. It is because the full path of DAEMON in /etc/init.d/shiny-server is not explicitly defined. If you change the line to

DAEMON=/usr/bin/shiny-server

then everything is fine...
